# Row T2. Two runs join the engine of the first. The first process exits. Exactly one joined command takes over the engine, and the other joins it. Both items finish.
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

example review-loop/project.star config/projects/orders.star
exec beehestreal item add orders ui-1 --title 'UI' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal item add orders base-1 --title 'Base' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal item add orders api-1 --title 'Api' --body-file body.txt

exec beehestreal run ui-1 orders --workflow flow/wait.star &ui&
waitstatus 'question of ui-1'
exec beehestreal run base-1 orders --workflow flow/wait.star &base&
waitstatus 'question of base-1'
exec beehestreal run api-1 orders --workflow flow/wait.star &api&
waitstatus 'question of api-1'
exec beehestreal answer ui-1 done
wait ui
exec beehestreal answer base-1 done
exec beehestreal answer api-1 done
wait base
stdout 'item base-1 finished'
wait api
stdout 'item api-1 finished'

-- body.txt --
Wait.
-- flow/wait.star --
def main(item):
    wait(name = "close", question = "question of " + item.id)
